input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Airy, magical, steadily pulsing music for a sky level where the hero climbs giant beanstalk leaves through the clouds in a cheerful 3D adventure game. A constant gentle pulse of plucked harp and celesta eighth notes, a soft steady kick and brushed snare groove, soaring legato strings and a sweet flute melody that keep rising, light glockenspiel accents. Hopeful, bright, sense of height and wonder, major key, steady 104 BPM in strict tempo, repeating 8-bar phrases, no intro fade, no ending, designed for seamless looping.

Instrumental orchestral piece without singing. Main theme for the opening screen of a cosy storybook family adventure game. A bright, catchy, bouncy melody on flute and clarinet over steady pizzicato strings and a light marching snare, warm horns answering, a cheeky bassoon counter-line, glockenspiel sparkles; the theme repeats in clear 8-bar phrases with a steady strict tempo of 112 BPM, major key, playful and heroic, no slow intro and no big ending, loop-friendly.
